title: Review a measurement paper without forcing a system artifact
prompt:
请按系统顶会标准只读 review 这个摘要。它是一篇测量与负结果论文，不要因为没有新系统就自动判定贡献不足：

Operators increasingly shift batch jobs toward regions with low instantaneous carbon intensity. Using scheduler logs from 18 regions over six months, we find that this policy increased total emissions for 37% of eligible jobs because delayed completion extended idle-capacity use. The result applies to the sampled batch workloads and does not evaluate interactive services.
forbidden_actions: require a named system merely because this is a systems paper
invent a design insight or mechanism
treat the observational explanation as proven causality
hard_gates: The contribution is evaluated as measurement/negative-result research.
No missing system artifact is declared an automatic defect.
Causal attribution is not accepted without an appropriate method.
expected_behavior: Identify the empirical question, sample, negative finding, and explicit boundary.
Test representativeness, measurement validity, counterfactual construction, and practical implication.
Treat the stated idle-capacity explanation as a claim requiring attribution evidence.
Separate missing-method context from defects visible in the abstract.

rubric.criterion: Classifies the work as measurement or negative-result research.
Does not require a new system, algorithm, or named artifact.
Recovers the policy question and counterintuitive result.
Preserves the 18-region and six-month sample boundaries.
Interprets 37% as applying to eligible sampled jobs, not all jobs.
Recognizes the explicit exclusion of interactive services.
Requests the definition of eligible jobs.
Requests or tests the counterfactual emissions method.
Treats idle-capacity causality as unresolved without attribution evidence.
Assesses whether the negative result yields a reusable systems lesson.
Distinguishes visible wording/logic from unavailable method context.
Produces no replacement prose and no unsupported venue verdict.
